response.sql: SELECT scans.zoneref AS site_code, sites.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(scans.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(scans.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.scancount >= 11 GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
